question: The Guindy National Park is located in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Guindy National Park** is located in the state of **Tamil Nadu**, India.
 
• It is situated in the capital city, **Chennai**, and is one of the smallest national parks in India, covering an area of approximately **2.70 square kilometers**.
 
• The park is home to a rich diversity of flora and fauna, including species like **spotted deer, blackbucks, and jackals**.
 
• Guindy National Park also houses a famous **Children’s Park** and a **Snake Park**, making it a popular destination for education and recreation.
 
• It is one of the few national parks located in the heart of a metropolitan city, providing a green refuge amidst urbanization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History of Guindy National Park**

 
 
• The park was originally part of the grounds of the **Raj Bhavan**, the official residence of the Governor of Tamil Nadu.
 
• It was declared a reserved forest in **1910** and later designated as a national park in **1978**.
 
 
 
• **Flora in the Park**
 
 
• The park’s vegetation is predominantly **dry evergreen scrub**, a rare type of forest found in South India.
 
• It also includes grasslands and over **350 species of plants** such as shrubs, climbers, and trees.
 
 
 
• **Fauna in the Park**
 
 
• The park supports over **150 species of birds**, including parakeets, koels, and flycatchers.
 
• It is also home to reptiles like **cobras, monitor lizards, and turtles**, along with amphibians and insects.
 
 
 
• **Other Attractions**
 
 
• The **Snake Park** inside Guindy National Park showcases a variety of snakes and reptiles and is managed by the Madras Crocodile Bank Trust.
 
• The **Children’s Park** features mini-zoos and play areas, making it a family-friendly location.
 
 
 
• **Conservation Efforts**
 
 
• The park plays a crucial role in the **conservation of endangered species** like the blackbuck.
 
• It also serves as a hub for **environmental education** and awareness programs for schools and the public.
